mod27_home_nudge_off_fwd2026_logloss.description: Fit 2020-25, scored on 2026 weeks 2-8 played games
mod27_home_nudge_off_fwd2026_logloss.plain_summary: Dropping the home-field nudge that is added to the model's projected margin before the key-number read. The nudge was large and favoured the away side in 2020-22, then turned to favour home from 2024. Positive means picks without the nudge scored better than the served picks, graded out of season against the opening line.
